The composition emphasizes the critical review process: one hand is pointing to a specific paragraph in a document while the other holds a pair of reading glasses. The lighting is crisp and natural, coming from a nearby window, highlighting the texture of the paper and the seriousness of the analysis, with no other people, electronics, or background objects visible.

Render only this scene.
